title: AO-MA Governor Decision
description: The AO-MA-11I run governor's decision for one check point of an autonomous run. The governor is a pure-decision policy: it reads the run budget, the run state, an injected 'now', and whether an operator PAUSE flag is present, and decides continue vs halt. It performs NO side effects: it does not write checkpoints, call the network, shell out, or invoke an LLM. When action=halt it sets safe_stop_required (the executor, not the governor, writes the safe-stop checkpoint) and escalation_required (consumed by AO-MA-11H notification). PAUSE is the highest-priority halt; all parse/clock/usage-axis anomalies fail closed to halt. The governor is NOT release authority and authorizes no GitHub writes or side effects (governor_authority const run_continuation_only, github_write_authorized const false, side_effect_authority const none).

action.description: continue: the autonomous run may proceed to the next step. halt: stop now.

halt_reason.description: Machine-readable halt reason code, or null when action=continue.

breached_limits.description: The specific budget limits breached. Empty when halt is due to PAUSE or an anomaly rather than a budget breach. The governor recomputes this from budget + state; it is never trusted from input.

safe_stop_required.description: True on halt: the executor must write a safe-stop checkpoint before stopping. False on continue.

escalation_required.description: True on halt: AO-MA-11H must notify/escalate to the operator. False on continue.

pause_present.description: Whether the operator PAUSE flag was present at evaluation time.

evaluated_at.description: When the governor evaluated this decision (stamped by the caller from the injected now).
